INSTRUMENT

The organising rule: brand colour and status colour are disjoint. Blue-violet is identity, links, focus and primary action — never state. Emerald / amber / rose / sky appear only where they encode a real verdict.

Every artboard has a dark toggle in its tweak row.

CHANGED FROM THE APPROVED PLAN

A threshold marker on the percentage bar would itself be a false signal — Gate 1 is ready at 94.4%, Gate 7 at 87.5%. Readiness is decided by all mandatory items being satisfied, not by crossing a percentage.

So the mandatory items are drawn as discrete pips. The pips are the verdict; the bar is only progress.

The Dashboard today shows only research telemetry — Running / Completed / Failed / Cost — and nothing about stage gates, which are now the larger half of the product.

Rebuilt to lead with what your roles make actionable.

Refusal is the product. Approve is unavailable AND the blockers are named beneath it; the requirement says who it is waiting on, and why you personally cannot approve it.

Advisory surfaces stay dashed, subordinate, and never render a percentage.
